charts.title: TOI-4511 b: orbits around TOI-4511
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-4511's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-4511 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lafarga et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.548ag512L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LAFARGA_ET_AL_2026): P 10.98090968596 d
